newsitem.title: USA: Dow's Q2 Performance segments profits off.
newsitem.headline: Dow's Q2 Performance segments profits off.

text.p: Dow Chemical Co said Thursday its Performance Plastics segment reported second quarter operating income of $257 million, down from $325 miillion a year ago, while its Performance Chemicals unit had operating income of $233 million, down from $237 million.

Combined sales for the two Performance segments were $2.7 billion, up three percent. That included higher sales of $1.32 billion for Performance Chemicals, up from $1.20 billion a year ago, and a drop in Performance Plastics sales to $1.34 billion from $1.37 billion.

Dow said price declines from last year's high levels, one-time events and an unfavorable currency impact on sales resulted in lower year-over-year operating income for both the Performance segments. However, operating income for these segments was higher than the first quarter of 1997, and they contributed about 60 percent of Dow's total operating income.
Dow said its Plastics segment recorded sales of $1.1 billion, up nine percent from a year ago. Operating income of $222 million was about equal with $223 million a year ago.

Within plastics, polystyrene prices were down significantly from the same period a year ago, offsetting volume gains in the emerging economies, Dow said. The polyethylene business is experiencing continued strong volume and improved pricing in North America and Europe.
Dow said its Chemicals and Metals segment had sales of $788 million, up from $768 million a year ago. Operating profit was $207 million, up from $205 million a year ago.
Hydrocarbons and Energy sales were up to $616 million from $595 million, while this segment posted break-even operating profit compared with a year-ago loss of $20.0 million.
